Optimal.Notes: The 40 Hz refresh rate and 40 fps cap gives the smoothest feel within the Deck's power budget; avatar quality for others at Medium is the key compromise between social experience and performance. Expect dips in crowded public lobbies.

profiles.Summary: VRChat runs on the Steam Deck with Proton (Gold/trending status), but performance is highly variable depending on the world and avatar complexity being rendered, as it is a socially-driven MMO with user-generated content. Expect significant frame rate swings based on player count and avatar polygon/shader density; busy public worlds will stress the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU considerably.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were found; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum requirements (GTX 970 minimum, well above the Deck's ~GTX 1050 Ti class GPU) and VRChat's known user-generated content variability. On first run, check frame rate in a busy public world and immediately reduce "Avatar Quality (Others)" if it drops below 30 fps.

MaxBattery.Notes: Lowering avatar quality for others is the single biggest lever for battery life in VRChat; busy worlds will still dip below 30 fps occasionally. Keep avatar download size cap low to reduce sudden loading spikes.
